The native Welcome to Lingual archive is converted with 996 recorded segments, pitch/rate/power metadata and two original recordings. Help loads it atomically on demand (31 MB) rather than forcing the native seed download or repopulating deleted entries automatically. Existing edited welcome content is retained. IndexedDB and validated session preferences restore entries and the active caret; JSON/WAV backup replaces NSCoding/CAF and Documents storage.
